fact: The World Bank concept-stage project document for Modernizing Ethiopia's Statistical System (P513304), prepared 7 March 2026 with approval estimated 5 November 2026, proposes Subcomponent 1.3 to strengthen the legal, methodological and technical foundations for using administrative data in official statistics, with common standards, automated data exchange and quality assurance in selected high-value sectors; not yet approved.
title: Modernizing Ethiopia's Statistical System (P513304)
